title: Blue Exorcist
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Teenager Rin Okumura learns he and his twin brother are sons of Satan, and that he alone inherited Satan's flames. After Satan kills their priest guardian, Rin enrolls at an academy for exorcists, a secret order under the Vatican, to learn to fight demons and defeat his father.
life_message: A good life is choosing to do right and protect others no matter where you came from.
